import re
from typing import List, Tuple

def _parse_version(v: str) -> Tuple[int, int, int, List[str]]:
    """
    Parse a Semantic Version string into its components.
    Returns (major, minor, patch, pre_release_list).
    Build metadata is ignored.
    """
    # Split out build metadata
    core, *_ = v.split('+', 1)
    # Split pre-release
    parts = core.split('-', 1)
    num_part = parts[0]
    pre = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    major, minor, patch = map(int, num_part.split('.'))
    pre_list = pre.split('.') if pre else []
    return major, minor, patch, pre_list

def _compare_identifiers(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    """
    Compare two pre-release identifiers according to SemVer rules.
    Return -1 if a < b, 0 if equal, 1 if a > b.
    """
    a_is_num = a.isdigit()
    b_is_num = b.isdigit()
    if a_is_num and b_is_num:
        a_val = int(a)
        b_val = int(b)
        return (a_val > b_val) - (a_val < b_val)
    if a_is_num and not b_is_num:
        return -1
    if not a_is_num and b_is_num:
        return 1
    # both non-numeric: compare ASCII
    return (a > b) - (a < b)

def compare_versions(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    """
    Compare two Semantic Version strings.
    Return -1 if a < b, 0 if a == b, 1 if a > b.
    """
    a_major, a_minor, a_patch, a_pre = _parse_version(a)
    b_major, b_minor, b_patch, b_pre = _parse_version(b)

    # Numeric comparison
    for av, bv in ((a_major, b_major), (a_minor, b_minor), (a_patch, b_patch)):
        if av != bv:
            return (av > bv) - (av < bv)

    # At this point major/minor/patch are equal
    # Handle pre-release presence
    if not a_pre and not b_pre:
        return 0
    if not a_pre:
        return 1  # a has no pre-release, so higher
    if not b_pre:
        return -1  # b has no pre-release, so higher

    # Compare pre-release identifiers
    for a_id, b_id in zip(a_pre, b_pre):
        cmp = _compare_identifiers(a_id, b_id)
        if cmp != 0:
            return cmp
    # All compared identifiers equal; longer pre-release is higher
    return (len(a_pre) > len(b_pre)) - (len(a_pre) < len(b_pre))
